title: Oscar and the Cellar
author: Wren Ishikawa
blurb: Xanthe Blackwood, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
